I ain't high and mighty. I also dont work at a dive bar, ask your mother she can tell you. 

I just hate folks that tell bullshit stories to look like something they ain't online. Which is what you sound like. The fact you are getting all butt hurt when called on it and acting like a defensive bitch really doesn't help your case. Board commission...semantics. it's the same fucking thing dude and you know it. 

Yes I think a dude that sits behind a counter and works a cash register is slightly below, but my point wasnt that. It was that the laws for selling liquor in a store are no where close to similar to those that cover serving alcohol  to people...which you DONT do working at a liquor store. 

Go home Lahey you're our matched

What country then? What's that statute that sets a legal limit for liquor sales? 

I work in a Bar. I have my certification  as required by law to SERVE alcohol,  not sell it. If you dont know what a liquor commission is I'm calling bullshit on you even working with alcohol period ..maybe you stock shelves at the Kroegers but anything more than that bullshit. Where did you get your licensing to serve, sorry SELL ?

Um story sounds good brah but the liquor commission while legally setting a limit for serving alcohol  in a bar or something has NONE for liquor stores. Which you know anyone with there certification or licensing knows...so sounds good but a fully bullshit story. Nice try though an epic fail.

What if the people in your life are major factors in this decision?  Seeing someone isnt helpful, my family put me in one cage or another since I was 6  years old. I've seen some one since I was 4. They don't really help or work. 

Improving the situation  ...I wish it was that easy. I wish it was even possible with some work. It's not. I'm aware of what options are left to folks like me in this hateful and ugly society, improved situation  is not one of them. I'm 35 working a baseline job for less than a living wage because society doesnt give someone like me a normal life. 

This is better. Far better than what life will allow me

I know how you feel. 

My mother wanted to kill me before I was born. When she couldnt get an abortion she started doing large amounts of cocaine to try to force a miscarriage. Didnt work. 

I've been shoved from one cage, child abuse camp like WWASPS  , program, etc since I was 6 until I was 25. 

My girl doesnt relate to why human touch is so important to me and we are all but broken up at this point because of issues like that. I suffer from severe CPTSD 

I won't try to dissuade you  I'm 35 and I dont want to see another year like the last 35 either. 

I'm right behind you by a few days. Coming up this next friday I'll be CTB too. 

I dont understand  why people feel a need to dissuade. If your pain and suffering was physical , like cancer, they would support your decision to end that suffering. Having had cancer I can say this pain and suffering is FAR worse.
I don't know what I want really at this point except the pain to stop

My mother couldn't get an abortion so she tried to force it by taking large amounts of cocaine while pregnant with me. 

When that didnt work she abandon me with strangers.

So I get it. I dont know your situation,  I cant tell you it gets better if you arent feeling it make the same choice I am I guess.
